yearT1.evidence_source: The substantive analysis followed a 3-step hierarchical regression analysis performed by Lehmann and colleagues (2015). To be precise, using cross-sectional and longitudinal data, life satisfaction at T1 and T2, emotional and psychological well-being at T1 and T2, and depressive symptoms at T1 and T2 were predicted from gender, age, and education at T1 (Step 1), relationship status at T1 (Step 2), and satisfaction with relationship status at T1 (Step 3). The results of this analysis for wave 1 and wave 2 are presented in Table 3.
